title: Commits in a site's baseline repo start no detached git gc, and teardown waits out one still running
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/webroot-repo-gc.test.mjs packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/teardown-volumes.test.mjs

S2: Record the exit code, the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines and the result of each case whose name starts with: "the baseline commit of a webroot past the gc threshold starts no automatic gc"; "a moment past the gc threshold starts no automatic gc either"; "every git call the webroot scripts make on a site repo carries the no-maintenance config"; "a git gc still running in the baseline repo is waited for, a bounded while, before the directory goes".
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 26).

Every named case is 'ok' (none 'not ok', none '# SKIP'): with git told to gc at once (gc.auto=1, foreground), a baseline commit and a moment leave no pack behind, every git call the webroot scripts make on a site repo carries the no-maintenance config, and teardown waits a bounded while for a gc.pid naming a live process on this host before removing the directory.
evidence: 05/10/2026 dev Mac, twice: deleting a site whose install had failed (initb-0510-wpz-a3) stopped at teardown step 3 with "rm: cannot remove '.../webroot-baseline.git': Directory not empty"; the one file left was gc.log ('unable to read 95727ea4...', 'failed to run repack') written by a detached automatic gc the baseline commit had started (ledger L14b). Red 9610fb9e2 (4 cases not ok on 04a0c6da2), fix cd45fa2b6.
fence: No shell git call on a site baseline repo can start automatic maintenance; teardown waits at most 10 s for a gc already running, and remove_path stays the net.

tests: the baseline commit of a webroot past the gc threshold starts no automatic gc
a moment past the gc threshold starts no automatic gc either
every git call the webroot scripts make on a site repo carries the no-maintenance config
a git gc still running in the baseline repo is waited for, a bounded while, before the directory goes
